material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the identical event: 36 border collies removed from a Palm City home on Aug. 10, now available for adoption Sept. 1 through Humane Society of the Treasure Coast. The incoming article provides extensive color details (condition quotes, medical specifics, adoption matching process, Tucker quotes) and mentions criminal charges/condemned home, but these are elaborative rather than material updates. The core news—legal surrender and Sept. 1 adoption opening—was already in the canonical. Additional detail about the dogs' condition, staff observations, and adoption procedures are reportorial depth on the same announcement, not a distinct newsworthy development.
